sources.title: GitHub - hao-ai-lab/FastVideo: A unified inference and post-training ...
sources.snippet: NEWS 2026/08/23: FastH3 Preview v0.2 is a 4-step DMD2-distilled MiniMax-H3 checkpoint that generates synchronized video and audio. Run the verified basic FastH3 example, see the inference guide, or have a coding agent install FastVideo with the agent setup prompt.

sources.title: FastVideo - haoailab.com
sources.snippet: FastVideo is an inference and post-training framework for diffusion models. It features an end-to-end unified pipeline for accelerating diffusion models, starting from data preprocessing to model training, finetuning, distillation, and inference.

sources.title: GitHub - EricLina/FastVideo-: A unified inference and post-training ...
sources.snippet: FastVideo is a unified post-training and inference framework for accelerated video generation. FastVideo features an end-to-end unified pipeline for accelerating diffusion models, starting from data preprocessing to model training, finetuning, distillation, and inference.
